descripcion: Fatty alcohol widely used as a co-emulsifier and consistency agent in cosmetic emulsions. It provides body, stability and a soft emollient feel to creams, lotions and hair conditioners. It is also used in pharmaceutical and veterinary bases, in cleaning products and in industrial applications; its use in foods and nutraceuticals depends on applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Ointments and pharmaceutical or veterinary bases
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, beads or pastilles, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mixture of the fatty alcohols cetyl and stearyl used as a consistency base in all kinds of emulsions. It stabilizes the oil phase and improves the sensory feel of creams and hair products. It is also used in pharmaceutical and veterinary bases and in cleaning products; its use in foods and nutraceuticals depends on applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Ointments and pharmaceutical or veterinary bases
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes or beads, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic fatty acid of the cosmetic industry, used to give body and opacity to emulsions and as a saponifiable base in shaving creams and creamy soaps. Its partial neutralization produces stable emulsified systems. In industry it is also used as a hardener in candles and soaps and as an auxiliary in plastics, and as an excipient in other sectors in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — beads, flakes or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ester of glycerin and stearic acid used as a primary emulsifier and consistency agent in oil-in-water emulsions. It provides stability, creaminess and a non-greasy finish highly valued in skin care products; it is also used as an excipient in pharmaceutical and veterinary semisolid bases and in household care, industrial and supplement formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, flakes or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic emulsifier derived from sugars and fatty alcohols, in high demand for natural-trend formulations. It produces stable emulsions with a light feel and is compatible with a wide range of cosmetic actives.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, flakes, or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Light emollient ester with fast spreadability, used to reduce the greasy feel of emulsions and improve the glide of body oils and makeup removers. It also acts as a vehicle for fragrances and oil-soluble actives, and as a solvent or vehicle in topical formulations for pharmaceutical, veterinary and industrial use.
aplicaciones: Vehicle in pharmaceutical and veterinary topical formulations
formas_referenciales: Low-viscosity oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Plant-derived emollient with excellent oxidative stability, valued for its dry, silky feel. It serves as a base oil phase, a carrier for oil-soluble actives and a support for extracts and fragrances, and as an oily excipient in pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations.
formas_referenciales: Light oily liquid, colorless to pale yellow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amphoteric surfactant derived from coconut, a mainstay of mild cleansing formulas. It boosts and stabilizes foam, reduces the irritation potential of anionic surfactants and adds viscosity to shampoos and liquid soaps.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, viscosity varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Non-ionic surfactant of the alkyl polyglucoside family, derived from sugars and vegetable fatty alcohols. Its mildness profile makes it ideal for sensitive-skin cleansers, baby products and natural-leaning formulas, and its biodegradable nature also makes it useful in surface cleaners and in hygiene products for pharmaceutical and veterinary use.
aplicaciones: Surface cleaners and pharmaceutical or veterinary hygiene cleansers
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — aqueous solution, shade varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mild anionic surfactant derived from coconut fatty acids, known for its creamy foam and excellent skin compatibility. It is the preferred base for syndet bars, solid shampoos, and cleansers with low irritation potential.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, granules, or needles depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reference humectant in the cosmetics industry and one of the most versatile raw materials on the market. It attracts and retains water in formulations, improves spreadability and works as a solvent and plasticizer; in foods, pharmaceutical formulations and supplements, its use is governed by applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Glycol of fermentative origin positioned as a clean-label alternative to propylene glycol. It acts as a humectant and as a solvent for actives and preservatives, with a less sticky feel than glycerin. It is also used in cleaning products and in topical pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, low-viscosity liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Vitamin B5 derivative used in formulations for skin and hair care, associated with humectant and conditioning properties. It is a classic active in hair products, hand creams and formulas for skin that needs comfort. It is also used in cleaning products, topical pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations and, according to applicable regulations, in nutrition.
formas_referenciales: Colorless viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Solid — powder depending on the commercial variant, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of hyaluronic acid, a biopolymer with a high water-retention capacity obtained by fermentation. It is a widely demanded humectant active, used in formulations associated with hydration and the appearance of smooth skin; in its high molecular weight variant it tends to form a surface film. It is also used in supplements and pharmaceutical preparations in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amino acid-derived humectant that is part of the skin's natural moisturizing factor. It is incorporated into formulations to improve water retention in skin and hair, with a mild profile and good compatibility with other ingredients.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to slightly amber aqueous solution depending on the batch

descripcion: Amide form of vitamin B3, one of the most widely used multifunctional actives in facial care today. It is used in formulations associated with tone uniformity, the appearance of pores and skin barrier comfort, with excellent stability and ease of formulation. It is also used as a source of vitamin B3 in supplements, fortified foods, veterinary premixes and pharmaceutical preparations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydroquinone glucoside obtained enzymatically, used in cosmetic formulations associated with an even-looking skin tone. It is a highly demanded active in facial care serums and creams because of its stability and compatibility with other cosmetic ingredients. It is also used in dermatological preparations for pharmaceutical and veterinary use, in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Creams for spots of cosmetic origin
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Alkaloid of the xanthine group, used as a cosmetic active in formulations for eye contour, body care and hair care, associated with a revitalized and firmer appearance of the skin. In foods, supplements and pharmaceutical products its use is governed by applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Beverages, supplements and pharmaceutical formulations, according to regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, particle size variable depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Main component of chamomile oil, used in formulations for sensitive skin and associated with a feeling of comfort and calm. It is available in natural and synthetic versions, both with a long track record in the cosmetics market.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid, colorless to slightly yellowish depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Lipid identical to those present in the stratum corneum of the skin, used in formulations associated with skin barrier care. It is an active used in cosmetic repair creams, dry skin products and dermocosmetic lines. Its use extends to dermatological, veterinary and nutrition formulations, according to applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — waxy powder or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic active with a long track record, used in formulations associated with skin comfort and softness. It is common in creams, hair products, toothpastes and after-sun formulas, and is also used in topical preparations for pharmaceutical and veterinary use, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder, particle size variable depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Dicarboxylic acid used as an active in cosmetic formulations for skin prone to blemishes and uneven tone, and as an input in dermatological preparations for pharmaceutical use. Its versatility positions it in serums, creams and gels for specialized facial care, always within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Short-chain alpha-hydroxy acid, a reference for cosmetic chemical exfoliation. It is used in formulations associated with renewing the appearance of the skin and a more even texture, at concentrations and pH in accordance with applicable cosmetic regulations. It is also used in dermatological preparations for pharmaceutical use, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Solid — crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Oil-soluble beta-hydroxy acid used in cosmetic formulations for oily skin and skin prone to blemishes, associated with exfoliation of the skin surface and the inside of the pore. It is also used as a preservation aid, as an input for topical pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, and as an intermediate in industry, in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Cleansers and toners for oily skin
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine crystalline powder, particle size variable depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Broad-spectrum preservative used for the antimicrobial protection of aqueous formulas and emulsions, within the limits of applicable regulations. It is compatible with most systems and is frequently combined with ethylhexylglycerin or other boosters. It is used in cosmetics, cleaning products, pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, and water-based industrial formulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, slightly viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reference fat-soluble antioxidant, used both to protect oily phases from oxidation and as an active associated with skin care. Available in natural-origin and synthetic variants; in foods, supplements and pharmaceutical uses, its use is governed by applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Viscous oily liquid — amber shade varies, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Organic UV filter used in sunscreens and daily care products with sun protection, within the limits of the applicable cosmetic regulations. It stands out for its photostability and for helping stabilize other filters in the formula, such as avobenzone.
aplicaciones: Hair care products with UV protection
formas_referenciales: Viscous oily liquid — variable yellowish shade depending on the batch

descripcion: Widely used organic filter for protection against UVA radiation, employed in sunscreens in accordance with the applicable cosmetic regulations. It is typically formulated alongside stabilizers such as octocrylene to maintain its photochemical performance.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, white to yellowish shade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Long-chain cationic surfactant, a benchmark in deep hair conditioning. It eases detangling, adds softness, and reduces frizz in conditioners, masks, and treatments, with a mildness profile superior to that of short-chain quats.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearls, pastilles, or flakes depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic quaternary ammonium for hair conditioning, used in rinses, styling creams and treatments. It provides detangling and static control, and also serves as a cationic emulsifier in conditioning systems. It is also used as a cationic auxiliary in cleaning products and other industrial formulations, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous or hydroalcoholic solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble cationic polymer used as a conditioner in rinse-off systems. It improves the feeling of softness of skin and hair during and after washing, and is a common additive in shampoos, shower gels and liquid soaps.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — colorless to slightly cloudy aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cationic derivative of guar gum used as a deposition conditioner in cleansing systems. It improves wet combability, softens the skin in shower gels, and contributes to the viscosity of the formula.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, white to yellowish shade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-viscosity cross-linked acrylic polymer, widely used to thicken and stabilize gels and emulsions. After neutralization it produces clear gels with a characteristic rheology, and suspends particles and actives with great efficiency at low use levels. It is also used in topical pharmaceutical and veterinary gels and in household care products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fluffy fine powder, grade and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reference silicone in personal care, available in multiple nominal viscosities. It provides a silky sensory feel, shine and a hydrophobic protective film on skin, hair and surfaces, and reduces the tackiness of emulsions. It is also used in skin protection products, cleaning polishes and industrial applications.
formas_referenciales: Silicone fluid — viscosity varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Dry-feel emollient with high affinity for skin lipids, currently obtained from plant sources such as sugarcane or olive. It is one of the most in-demand natural alternatives to silicones, with excellent stability and a light sensory feel. It is also used as an oily vehicle in topical pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations and in nutraceutical line products.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, odorless oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Universal chelating agent that sequesters metal ions present in water and raw materials. It protects the color, aroma and stability of formulas, and improves the performance of preservative and foaming systems. It is used in cosmetics, cleaning products, industry and, in line with applicable regulations, in pharmaceutical, veterinary, nutraceutical and food preparations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reference white pigment in the color industry, valued for its covering power and opacifying capacity. The rutile crystalline form is associated with good weathering stability, and is therefore used in paints and coatings, and in foundations and pressed powders. Treated and untreated variants exist on the market; the specific quality is confirmed in the technical data sheet of the available batch.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; particle size and surface treatment vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Red inorganic pigment with high stability to light and heat, a cornerstone of skin-tone coloration in makeup. Combined with yellow and black iron oxides, it allows the full range of foundations, concealers, and blushes to be built. The exact shade varies between manufacturers and batches, so validation against a color standard is recommended.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; shade and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Yellow inorganic pigment used in building skin tones and warm-undertone concealers. Its chemical stability makes it suitable for hot processes and for anhydrous or emulsified systems. It is routinely combined with red and black iron oxides to adjust the palette of foundations and powders.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; shade and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-intensity black inorganic pigment, a key player in eye products such as mascaras and eyeliners. It is also used in small proportions to darken and deepen skin tones in foundations and powders. Its stability to light makes it reliable in long-shelf-life formulas.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; hue and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic blue pigment with a long tradition in color cosmetics and soapmaking. It provides blue to violet shades in eyeshadows and eyeliners, and is used to neutralize yellowish undertones in powders. It is sensitive to acidic media, so compatibility should be evaluated in each formula system.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; shade intensity varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Opaque green inorganic pigment prized for its excellent stability to light, heat, and solvents. It is used in eyeshadows, eyeliners, and color products where deep, long-lasting greens are required. It is also used as a corrector for reddish undertones in pigment blends, subject to regulations governing use by application area.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; hue varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Lamellar mineral with a platelet structure that provides soft luster, slip, and transparency to color products. It works as a texture filler in powders and eyeshadows, and is the traditional substrate for pearlescent pigments. Particle size defines the visual effect, from satin finishes to sparkle, depending on the manufacturer's grade.
formas_referenciales: Solid — lamellar powder; particle size and luster vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Lab-made alternative to natural mica, associated with a cleaner luster and fully controlled traceability of origin. It is used as a substrate for pearlescent pigments and as an effect filler in premium-positioned color products. Its transparency makes it attractive for highlighters and eyeshadows with an intense finish.
formas_referenciales: Solid — lamellar powder; particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Effect pigment composed of mica platelets coated with titanium dioxide, producing pearly luster and interference effects. It is the most widely used family of pearlescent pigments in eyeshadows, highlighters, and lipsticks with a luminous finish. The visual effect depends on the coating thickness and the particle size of the grade, which are confirmed in the technical data sheet (TDS) of the batch.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearlescent lamellar powder; effect and particle size vary depending on the grade, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic pearlescent agent that provides a silky pearly luster and remarkable adhesion to the skin. It is used in pressed powders, eyeshadows, and nail polishes to achieve satin finishes with a creamy appearance. Protecting it from light during storage is recommended to preserve its appearance.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pearlescent powder; luster and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic mineral filler of color cosmetics, appreciated for its glide, softness and ability to dilute pigments. It is the historical base of loose and pressed powders, blushes and eyeshadows, and is also used as a diluent and lubricant in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical powders, tablets and capsules. The applicable grade is defined with the manufacturer's supporting documentation for each batch.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; particle size and whiteness vary depending on origin, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fine-grained mica with a silky feel, regarded as a noble filler for powder makeup. It provides adhesion, slip, and a soft finish with subtle luster in foundations, powders, and eyeshadows. Surface-treated grades exist to improve affinity with anhydrous systems, according to each manufacturer's portfolio.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine lamellar powder; particle size and treatment vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Lamellar ceramic material with an exceptionally soft feel, used as a high-end texturizer in powder makeup. It provides creamy slip, adhesion, and a light-diffusing effect associated with soft-focus finishes. It is used in premium powder, foundation, and eyeshadow formulas to elevate the feeling of luxury.
formas_referenciales: Solid — lamellar powder; particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Functional filler used in makeup formulations to mattify, absorb sebum, and improve powder flow. It contributes to a blurred finish that visually softens the appearance of lines and pores. Spherical and amorphous grades with different absorption profiles are available depending on the manufacturer.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; morphology and absorption capacity vary depending on the grade, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Plant-based filler with a soft, velvety feel, used as a natural alternative to talc in powder makeup. It provides moisture and sebum absorption, and a natural-looking matte finish. It is a frequent option in formulas positioned as natural or vegan, and is also used as an excipient in pharmaceutical and veterinary powders and as a bulking agent in foods.
aplicaciones: Excipient in pharmaceutical and veterinary powders
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Magnesium salt of stearic acid used as a lubricant and anti-sticking agent in the compression of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical tablets and capsules. In cosmetics it improves the compressibility, adhesion and slip of pressed powders and eyeshadows, with some water repellency. In foods it is used as an anticaking agent, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; bulk density varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amino acid derivative used as a silky-feel texturizer in powder makeup and in pigment surface treatments. It improves adhesion to the skin, pigment dispersion, and the creamy sensation on application. It is common in mineral formulas and in those positioned as gentle on the skin.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine lamellar powder; particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Structuring vegetable wax widely used in lipsticks, providing hardness, shine and good mold release. It is a plant-based alternative to beeswax in vegan formulas. In foods and in pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical products it is used as a coating or glazing agent, in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Coating of tablets, fruits and confectionery
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pellets or chunks, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: One of the vegetable waxes with the highest hardness and melting point in common cosmetic use. It provides rigidity, shine and heat resistance in lipsticks, pencil eyeliners and mascaras. In foods and in pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical products it is used as a glazing and coating agent in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes or chunks, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic natural wax that provides plasticity, body and a creamy texture to lipsticks and stick products. Its compatibility with a wide range of oils and emollients makes it very versatile in anhydrous systems, and it also provides film-forming action and support for emulsion stability. It is marketed in yellow and bleached grades depending on the supplier, and in foods, pharmaceuticals and veterinary products it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Ointments and pharmaceutical or veterinary bases
formas_referenciales: Solid — pastilles, beads or blocks, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Petroleum-derived wax with a fine crystalline structure that provides flexibility and cohesion to stick products. It is associated with reduced oil exudation in lipsticks and greater resistance to stick breakage. It is also used as a base and consistency agent in pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical products, and in foods as a coating agent in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pellets, flakes or slabs, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Film-forming silicone resin used in long-wear makeup formulations. It is associated with transfer- and rub-resistant finishes in lipsticks, foundations, and eyeliners. It is usually incorporated dissolved in the volatile solvent phase of the formula.
formas_referenciales: Solid — resin in powder or flakes depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — solution in volatile solvent depending on the supplier's presentation

descripcion: Polymeric pigment dispersant for oil-based media, key in fluid foundations and liquid lipsticks. It coats the particles of pigments and inorganic filters, improving milling, dispersion stability, and color uniformity. It helps prevent sedimentation and flocculation over the product's shelf life.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid to waxy paste depending on the temperature, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Organic lake colorant traditionally used in lipsticks, delivering intense pink to red shades with good tinting strength. Because it is fixed on an insoluble substrate, it allows anhydrous systems to be colored without color migration. Its use is governed by the positive lists of colorants in each market.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; intensity and hue vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Natural colorant obtained from cochineal, with a long tradition in the Andean region and highly valued for its intense, stable reds. In makeup it is used in lipsticks, blushes, and eyeshadows where a red of natural origin is sought. In food and beverages it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Food and beverages in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; intensity and hue vary depending on the manufacturer and batch
